title: A spinor-adapted geometric approach for nonlinear Dirac systems and its application to a tensorial wave-Dirac system near Minkowski spacetime
summary: We study a nonlinear tensorial wave-Dirac system on $(1+3)$-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes as a semilinear model motivated by the Maxwell-Dirac and Einstein-Dirac systems. The purpose of this model is to isolate the interaction between the null geometry of antisymmetric tensor fields and the intrinsic first-order geometry of the Dirac equation while avoiding the derivative loss mechanism of the Einstein equations and the gauge structure of the Maxwell equations.
